newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Chirac wants EU to remain a major farm exporter.
newsitem.headline: Chirac wants EU to remain a major farm exporter.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said on Thursday he supported farm reform provided that the EU remained a major exporter and revenues did not decline.

"France very much wants Europe to remain a major agricultural producer, a major exporter of farm products and that farm revenues are protected," he told a news conference at the end of an official visit to the European Commission.
Chirac was responding to a question on the Commission's Agenda 2000 programme to prepare for EU expansion eastwards which was presented to the European Parliament on Wednesday.
Chirac said he supported the Commission's proposal that farm reforms started in 1992 should be continued on condition that the farm export and revenue objectives were respected.
This was possible under the EU agricultural budget provided that non-farm items were not added to it, he said.
